name: DXPR AI Provider
description: This enables the use of DXPR AI for the AI module.
project_description: Registers DXPR AI (the DXAI Kavya platform) as an AI provider plugin for the drupal/ai framework, giving Drupal chat, text-to-image, image-to-image and native text-translation operations against an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The Kavya gateway fronts multiple upstream models (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, xAI, MistralAI) with automatic failover, optional web research, EU-resident routing (kavya-m1-eu) and long-form generation. The module builds an openai-php client on Drupal's HTTP client (base URI defaults to kavya.dxpr.com/v1, overridable), authenticates with a Bearer token resolved from a Key entity, and adds DXPR-specific request fields (provider priority, allowed HTML tags/classes, web_search, structured JSON schema). It ships a content-aware translate_text prompt engine (HTML-aware, RTL detection, prompt-injection guarding) and an em-dash post-processing mode (0-3, with per-language overrides) applied to generated text. The settings form (gated by the 'administer ai providers' permission) shows account credit usage, lets operators order providers, and validates the key against the live API. Requires the AI, Key and DXPR Builder modules.
